tei:titleStmt.tei:title: ༄༅/ /dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i rim lnga'i zin bris snying po'i don gsal ba'i me long zhes bya ba bzhugs so/
༄༅/ /dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i rim lnga'i zin bris snying po'i don gsal ba'i me long zhes bya ba bzhugs so/

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i rim lnga'i zin bris snying po'i don gsal ba'i me long zhes bya ba bzhugs so/

/rdo rje theg pa'i nges don ma lus pa'i// snying por gyur pa rim pa lnga yi khrid// rin chen mu tig star la rgyus pa bzhin// ston mdzad gang yin drin can bla ma la// lus ngag yid gsum gus pas phyag 'tshal lo// 'dir dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i rim lnga'i rnal 'byor/ dam pa'i gsung bzhin cung zad cig brjod na/ thog mar yid ches shing khungs btsun par byed pa chos 'di'i byung tshul bla ma rgyud pa'i rim pa dang*/ gnyis pa brgyud pa de las byung ba'i bskyed rdzogs so// dang po ni/ rgyal po ind+ra bhu ti pho brang du bzhugs pa'i dus su/ nam mkha'i mthongs su/ rgyal ba bcom ldan 'das 'khor bcas sgra mi snyan nas bya ngang pa'i tshogs ltar phebs pa rgyal pos gzigs nas/ blon po chos la mkhas pa rnams la 'di rnams ci red ces gsungs pas/ blon po rnams kyis dgra bcom pa 'khor dang bcas pa bcom ldan 'das te/ gdugs tshod la spyan drangs na phebs zhes gsol pas/ rgyal pos spyan drangs te/ chos zhus pas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' bstsal pa/ sangs rgyas kyi yon tan rnams thob par 'dod na/ 'dod pa'i yon tan rnams spongs la chos gyis gsungs pas/ rgyal pos gsol ba/ lum bi'i tshal ni nyams dga' bar// wa nyid seng ger gyur kyang bla'i// 'dod yon spong ba'i sangs rgyas ni// go'u tam nam yang mi 'tshal lo// zhes 'dod yon spong ba las ngan song du gnas na yang rung ngo zer/ bcom ldan 'das kyis theg pa chen po'i chos kyis 'dul ba'i dus la bab par dgongs te/ dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor mngon sum du sprul te/ dbang bskur rgyud smin par mdzad nas grol lam khrid 'di gnang zhes pa dang*/ de la brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang*/ tilli pa/ nā ro pa/ mar pa sogs nas brgyud pa'i lugs dang*/ gzhan yang brgyud pa grags su che ba la/ mar 'gos kyi lugs las/ 'gos zhes pa rta nag tu sku 'khrungs pa des gsan pa'i brgyud pa ni/

lo tsā ba de nyid kyis rgya gar nas spyan drangs pa yin la/ thog mar klu sgrub/ rig pa'i khu byug tilli pa/ nā ro pa/ mar pa sogs nas brgyud pa rim gyis de nas 'chad par byed/ dngos gzhi la/ chos 'di dang gsang sngags kun la slob ma snod dang ldan pa zhig dgos nges pas/ gang zag gi rim pa cung zad cig brjod par bya ste/ de la utpal lta bu'i gang zag ni/ rgyud la chos la sogs pa bstan kyang thams cad da lta nyid brjed 'gro ste/ dpe chu la ri mo bris pa dang 'dra ba lta bu dang*/ pad dkar lta bu ni rgyud la chos nyan bshad ci byas kyang nges zhing gsal bar brtan/ gzhan don gtan nas mi nus pa thig lta bu dang*/ padma dmar po lta bu ni/ rgyud bshad sgrub rnams yod kyang nus pa mi thon pa snyug ma tshigs med du chu bstabs pa lta bu dang*/ tsan dan lta bu'i gang zag ni/ rgyud la yon tan bshad sgrub gang yang yod cing*/ dper na tsan dan gyi sdong po dri nus pa lo 'dab phyogs bcur rgyas pa sogs yod kyang*/ sbruul 'khril nas len mi nus pa lta bu dang*/ rin po che lta bu'i gang zag la sbas don mthar thug spyi don gang yang ston cing*/ khyad par nges don 'ba' zhig ston par byed pas so// khrid dngos kyi gzhung ni rtsi lugs mang yang*/ slob dpon 'phags pa'i spyod bsdus sgron me las/ dang por sangs rgyas kyi theg pa la slob/ de'i rjes su theg pa gsar pa dran pa gcig pa'i ting nge 'dzin la slob/ de'i rjes su rtog pa'i rim pa la slob/ de'i rjes su rigs kyi dbye ba la 'jug de'i rjes su phra thig gi rnal 'byor la slob ces dang*/ yang sgron gsal las/ bskyed pa'i rim pa dang po ste// sems la dmigs pa gnyis pa'o// yid 'ong rim pa gsum pa ste// kun rdzob don dam dmigs pa ni// bzhi pa yin par rgyal bas gsungs// zung du 'jug pa lnga pa'o// zhes dang*/ dang por sangs rgyas kyi theg pa la slob tshul/

rim gyis 'jug pa'i tshul ni/ dpal brtag pa gnyis pa las/ skal med sems can gdul dka' ba// gang gi 'dul bar 'gyur ba lags// zhus pa'i lan/ dang por gso sbyong sbyin par bya// zhes sogs kyis bstan pa ltar rim gyis slob tshul ni/ thog mar mdo lang kar gshegs pa la/ ri la rtswa skye tshul/ rdza bzo tshul ltar dang*/ yang dpa' bar 'gro ba'i mdo las/ 'phong slob tshul ni/ dang por ko ba shing leb rnams la sbyangs te/ mthar mtshan mo me khyer gyi dmigs sogs gang bde su phog pa 'dra ba'i tshul gyi ston pa ni/ rim gyis ltar bsgrubs pas/ 'chi ba mi rtag pa bsgom tshul/ las rgyu 'bras 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs thar pa'i phan yon/ bsags pa bgrang ba/ tshad med bzhi sgom tshul/ dkon mchog la skyabs su 'gro tshul/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor rnams bsgom par bya ste/ mi rtag bsgom pa'i dus su/ mgon po klu sgrub kyis bshes spring las rgya cher bstan cing*/ pha dam pa'i ding ri brgya rtsa las/ nags kyi nang du spre'u skyid snyam 'phyo// nags mtha' me yis bskor ro ding ri ba// 'khor ba'i chu bo bzhi yis 'khyer dogs na// gru rdzings tshags su tshud cig ding ri ba// rang nyid 'chi ba yong snyam mi 'dug ste// 'chi bdag myur du sleb cing yong nyan pas// rtag tu 'gro tshis gyis shig ding ri ba// zhes rgyas par gsungs shing*/ mdor na/ mi rtag pa bsgom dgos kyi/ 'jig rten pha rol du 'gro nges pas/ shi nas kyang med mi 'gro bas/ las dkar nag gi rjes su 'brang dgos te/ mdo las/ lus kyi legs par spyad pa dang*// ngag gi legs par spyad pa dang*// yid kyi legs par spyad pa rnams// mtho ris su ni 'gro bar 'gyur// lus kyi nyes par spyad pa dang*// ngag gi nyes par spyad pa dang*// yid kyi nyes par spyad pa rnams// ngan song dang ni ngan 'gro dang*// dmyal ba rnams su skye bar 'gyur// zhes pas las dkar nag gi gnas skabs mthar thug gi phan yon nyes dmigs rnams bsam ste/

'di las thar bar byed pa la dkon mchog skyabs su 'gro zhing blo 'gel dgos te/ de ltar rang nyid zhi bde 'dod par ma zad/ sems can 'gro drug pha mar ma gyur pa med pas 'di rnams thar pa'i sa la 'god pa'i don gyis byams snying rje dga' ba btang snyoms sgom la sngon du byang chub kyi sems smon 'jug don dam rnams bsgoms te/ dus 'di nas zung ste ji srid 'tsho'i bar/ byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar sogs dge ba la lus ngag yid gsum bskul bar bya snyam pa lan gsum byed/ don dam pa byang chub kyi sems ni yid la mi byed pa dus gsum gyi rtog pas dben pa zhig byed de/ mgon po klu sgrub kyi zhal nas/ rang sems gdod nas ma skyes pa// stong pa nyid kyi rang bzhin no// de nyid bsgom pa'i rnal 'byor pas// dbugs gtong rngub pa ma yin zhing*// spyan phye btsum pa'ang ma yin zhing*// sgye ba ma yin sgu ba'ang min// phyi rol yul la mi rtog ste// nang du sems la mi rtog go// zhes pas so// byin rlabs 'jug pa bla ma'i rnal 'byor ni bla ma'i zhal las shes te/ mgon po klu sgrub kyi rim lnga las/ ri dbang rtse nas 'ga' zhig lhung 'gyur na// ltung bar mi 'gyur snyam yang ltung bar 'gyur// bla ma'i drin gyis grol ba'i lung thob na// grol ba mi 'gyur snyam yang grol bar 'gyur// zhes rgyas par gsungs so// gnyis pa theg pa gsar pa dran pa gcig pa'i ting nge 'dzin la slob ces pa'i tshul la/ theg gsar la zhes pas/ sngon sangs rgyas gtsug tor can nas sangs rgyas 'od srungs bar gsang sngags kyi chos mi dar gsungs pa ltar na bzhed ces pas gsar zhes pa'i don dang*/ mgon po byams pa la sogs pas phyis kyang 'byung dka' zhes pas kyang gsal zhes so// dran pa gcig pa zhes pas/ gcig tu lha dran pa dang lha dang gcig tu dran pa zhes pa 'di bsgoms pas bskyed pa'i rim pa rdo rje 'chang mi bskyod par sgom pa bla ma'i zhal las gsal te/

bskyed rim la rigs mang du byed de/ rigs grangs med par byed/ de yang rigs kyi dbye lugs la byed na/ mi bskyod pa lta bu zhig la rigs nyi shu 'byed de/ mi bskyod pa'i yul lnga/ yul can lnga/ gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya lnga/ dbang po lnga rnams ltar rigs lnga la bsgres nas byed/ ye shes lnga yang sbyar nas dam pa rigs brgyar dbye/ bsdu na nyi shu rtsa lnga po la tha dad du bsdu ba sogs go sla ste/ dpal brtag pa gnyis pa las/ dbye ba'i rigs la grangs ni med par 'gyur// zhes sogs rgyas par bstan cing*/ de las bsdus na rigs brgya dang*/ lnga dang gsum dang gnyis dang gcig tu bsdus nas bstan te/ mtshan yang dag par brjod pa las/ ha la ha la gdong brgya pa// zhes dang*/ sangs rgyas lnga bdag cod pan can// spyan lnga chags pa med pa 'chang*// zhes dang*/ yang*/ 'jig rten 'jig rten 'das pa'i rigs// zhes dang yang*/ ye shes mig gcig dri ma med// ces sogs rgyas par gsungs pa dang*/ dpal brtag pa gnyis pa las/ rigs ni rnam pa brgyad rnams kyis// mdor bsdus pas ni rnam pa lnga// sku gsung thugs kyi dbye ba yi// phye nas rnam pa gsum du 'gyur// zhes dang*/ rigs dang bgrang bya 'di yis ni// rigs zhes mngon par brjod par bya// zhes rgyas par bgrang zhing*/ mdor bsdu na/ de bzhin gshegs pa rdul phra rab kyi grangs dang mnyam pa gzhi dus nas gnas pa de rnal 'byor pas lam du slong*/ de nyams su len dgos te/ dpal gsang ba 'dus pa las/ mdor na phung po lnga rnams ni/ sangs rgyas lngar ni rab tu grags// zhes dang*/ rdo rje slob dpon lus 'di la// rgyal ba'i sku ni rim bzhin gnas// 'di yi gzugs kyi phung po ni// bcom ldan sangs rgyas rnam snang mdzad// ces sogs dang*/ de lta bu'i bskyed rim la brtan pa thob nas/ rdzogs pa'i rim pa rtogs pa'i rnal 'byor la slob dgos te/ sngon 'gro dben pa gsum bstan pa/

dngos gzhi bden pa bzhi bsgom pa/ rjes zung du 'jug pa dang gsum/ de la thog mar sku yi dben pa sgom tshul gong du smos pa ltar/ tha mal gyi zhen pa zlog pa de yin te/ dpal phag mo gru pas/ 'ja' tshon lta bu'i lha sku bsgom// dgos pa tha mal gyi zhen pa zlog /ces dang*/ dpal brtag pa gnyis pa las/ sems ni chen po gcig nyid la// lnga lnga'i gzugs kyi rnam par bsgom// zhes sogs kyis bstan te/ rigs gsum du bsdus te/ rin 'byung snang mtha' gnyis la sku rdo rje/ 'od dpag don grub gnyis la gsung rdo rje/ mi bskyod pa rdo rje 'chang gnyis la thugs rdo rje dang gsum zhes bsdu/ de yang rigs thams cad bsdus te gsang chen rdo rje 'chang gi sku gcig tu bsgom ste/ rgyud phyi ma las/ gsang ba mchog gi rigs gcig nyid// ces sogs ltar bsgom pas/ bskyed rim la brtan pa thob ste reg bya la thogs pa med pa dang*/ gang snang lha skur shar te tha mal gyi zhen pa med pa sogs lus dben mthar son pa 'byung zhes rgyud las gsungs shing*/ ngag dben la ka dpe las/ ngag dben pa dang*/ rlung bsgom pa zhes gsungs te/ skyes bu khams snyoms pa gcig la las rlung nyi khri chig stong drug brgya rgyu ste/ rtsa ba'i rlung lnga/ yan lag gi rlung lnga dang bcu zhes pas rtsa ba'i rlung lnga ni/ gyen rgyu mgrin pa na gnas/ srog 'dzin snying kha na gnas/ mnyam gnas lte ba na gnas/ thur sel 'doms su gnas/ khyab byed tshig rnams su gnas te/ re re la dgu re rgyu zhing*/ yan lag gi rlung lnga ni/ rgyu ba dang rab tu rgyu ba dang*/ nges par rgyu ba dang*/ shin tu rgyu ba dang*/ rnam par rgyu ba dang lnga ste/ rgyu ba mig nas rgyu ste gzugs sogs rig rab tu rgyu ba rna ba nas rgyu ste sgra rnams thos/ nges par rgyu ba sna nas rgyu ste dri rnams tshor/ shin tu rgyu ba kha nas rgyu ste ro bro ba rnams tshor/

rnam par rgyu ba lus la gnas te reg bya rtsub 'jam rnams tshor ba yin/ zhes dang*/ mgon po klu sgrub kyis/ rlung zhes bya bas las kun byed// 'di ni rnam shes bzhon pa ste// lnga yi bdag nyid bcu'i ming can// zhes dang*/ rlung gi las thams cad byed pas/ rnam rtog 'khor ba sgrub byed rlung*// zhes dang*/ ngag dben sgom pa'i dus ni/ me rlung sna bug g.yas nas rgyu dus dmar cha che ba'i kha dog lnga rgyu ba dang*/ thur sel sna bug g.yon nas rgyu ba ljang ser cha che ba'i kha dog sna lnga rgyu ba dang*/ srog 'dzin mnyam gnas gnyis sna bug dbus su rgyu ba bzhi rnams kha dog lnga lnga ste/ dgongs pa lung ston las/ rin chen lnga yi rnam pa yis// sna yi nang nas rgyu bar byed// ces kha dog rnams ni 'ja' lta bu// zhes sogs bsgom dgos shing*/ bzlas pa'i dus su/ dgongs pa lung ston las/ yi ge oṃ gyis yang dag bsdu/ rlung 'byung rngub gnas gsum lngar sgrub ste/ rngub pa'i dus su oṃ/ gnas pa'i dus su āḥ 'gyu ba'i dus su hūm̐ rnams dmigs par byed cing*/ de la yang rlung zhes pa mgon po lnga'i rlung zhes rtsa ba'i rlung lnga la dgu brgya re dang*/ lha mo bzhi'i rlung zhes bzhi bzhi zhes mgon po lnga'i 'khor du 'byung bas hril te dril ba/ las rlung nyi khri gcig stong rgyu ba yin/ de la mgon po bzhi zhes pas/ rdo rje mgon po snying kha'i srog 'dzin dang*/ rin chen mgon po mgrin pa dang*/ don grub mgon po mnyam gnas dang*/ mi bskyod mgon po thur sel gyi rlung dang bzhi'o// de la lha mo lnga zhes pas/ sa rlung gi rlung dang*/ sa rlung gi chu rlung*/ sa rlung gi me rlung*/ sa rlung gi rlung ste bzhi dang*/ de bzhin du/ chu rlung gi dang*/ me rlung gi dang*/ rlung gi rlung sogs bzhi bzhi byas nas lha mo bzhi'i rlung dang bcas pa'o// zhes bshad/ nyams su len pa'i dus su/

mar pa'i lugs ltar rang gi khong pa stong par bsgoms te rlung kha dog lngar bsgom zhing 'byung rngub gnas gsum du sgrub ste/ 'di la rlung gi de kho na nyid dang*/ yi ge'i de kho na nyid dang*/ sgra don gyi de kho na nyid dang gsum yin te/ rlung gi de kho na nyid gong du bstan pa ltar bsgoms pas/ sa brgyad pa thob pa dang*/ lha mo bzhi'i zhal mthong ba dang*/ zhi rgyas dbang drag gi dngos grub thob cing sa brgyad pa thob pa'i gang zag tu 'gyur te zhes rgyas par bstan pa ltar sgrub/ yi ge'i don de kho na nyid la gong du smos pa ltar yi ge gsum du yang dag gnas/ zhes pa ltar sngags su gsang ba 'dus pa ltar na/ dang po'i yi ge dang por bzhag /dbyangs yig lnga pas yang dag brgyan// sde tshan lnga pa'i mtha' bar can// yi ge gsum du yang dag brjod// ces bshad pa ltar sgrub/ yang dbyangs gsal las btu ba yang yod pa gang bde byed cing*/ yi ge'i de kho na nyid bstan pa yin no// sgra don gyi de kho na nyid ces pa/ sgra thams cad nam mkha' sogs kun la khyab pa yin te/ rab 'byor gyis zhus pa'i lung las/ sgra de dag ni nam mkha' las byung ngo*// zhes pas lus dben ngag dben sems dben gsum ston te/ sems dben pa la slob tshul ni/ thog mar mar lugs ltar rang nyid khong pa stong sangs pa bsgoms pa'i spyi bo na zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par padma dmar po'i steng du āḥdamar po/ snying khar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ sngon po gsum snang mched thob gsum yi ge'i tshul du bsgom zhing*/ yang lte ba'i dkyil du 'khor lo dkar po rtsibs brgyad pa'i steng du oṃ dkar po rnams bsgom ste/ lte ba'i oṃ las 'od dkar pos khengs te/ 'jug pa'i oṃ lte ba'i oṃ la thim par yang bsgom/ de'i rjes su lte bar 'khor lo'i steng du nyi gdan la rdo rje rtse lnga pa zhig bsgom/

de'i rtsa bar āḥdamar po tsheg drag dang bcas pa byu ru'i mdog lta bu zhig bsgom/ de las 'od dmar po 'phros/ nang gang*/ mgrin pa'i āḥbyung ba lte ba'i āḥl thim pa rnams bsgom/ yang lte bar 'khor lo'i dkyil du thig le sngon po zhig bsgom/ de las 'od 'phros yang snying kha'i hūm̐ byung ste/ lte ba'i thig le la thim par bsgom zhing*/ mthar thams cad mi dmigs par bsgom pa gnad ma 'chug pa yin te/ lung las/ stong pa dang*/ shin tu stong pa dang*/ stong chen po dang*/ thams cad stong nyid sogs so// rgyas par phye na stong nyid bco brgyad rnams su shes so// yang sna tshogs dga' ba dang*/ rnam smin gyi dga' ba dang*/ rnam bral gyi dga' ba rnams snang mched thob gsum du sbyar te bshad/ mtshan bral gyi dga' ba zhes pa mtshan nyid thams cad dang bral bas te/ dpal brtag pa gnyis pa las/ sna tshogs dang po dga' ba nyid// rnam smin la ni mchog dga' nyid// rnam bral lhan cig skyes dga' nyid// bcom ldan gsang ba shes rab dang*// bzhi pa yang ni de bzhin no// zhes bshad pas/ thog mar dmigs pa dang pos/ 'jug pa las gyur pa'i rtog pa sum cu rtsa gsum 'gag dper na snang ba'i ngo bo zla ba shar ba lta bu mthong*/ dmigs pa gnyis pas gnas pa las gyur pa'i rtog pa bzhi bcu 'gag ste/ snang ba'i ngo bo nyi ma shar ba lta bu mthong*/ dmigs pa gsum pas ldang ba las gyur pa'i rtog pa bdun 'gag nye bar thob pa'i ngo bo mun nag lta bu rnams mthong bar 'gyur/ de'i rjes la/ snang mched thob gsum gyi rjes su thams cad stong pa'i 'od gsal 'char ba rnams gzhi dus la gnas pa de/ da lta rnal 'byor pas lam du blangs pas/ lam rtags bcu rnams dang lnga sogs mthong ste/ sprin med nam mkha' mthong ba rtags chen te/ phag mo dpyal lugs las/ dang po ri dwags srid zhi'i rnam pa ste// mtshan ma gnyis pa du ba lta bu dang*// gsum pa mkha' snang lta bu ste// bzhi pa mar me 'bar ba lta bu'o// mtshan ma lnga pa rtag tu snang ba ni// sprin med nam mkha' ji bzhin no// zhes pas rtags chen ni/

thams cad stong pa'i rmad po che// dwangs shing gsal ba'i ye shes che// zhes sogs ltar nyams su len dgos te/ 'di 'chad par byed pa la/ ye shes kyi phyag rgya bsten par bya ste/ rang lha sku gang rung du bskyed pa'i snying kha nas/ rig ma rdo rje dbyings kyi dbang phyug ma lta bu lo bcu drug sogs lon pa dang snyoms par 'jug pa'i bde bas/ ma rgyud pa ltar na/ dga' bzhi zhes pa spyi bo nas 'bab pa dgos/ mgrin pa nas mchog dga'/ snying kha na khyad dga'/ rdo rje nor bu'i rtser sleb nas lhan skyes kyi dga' ba bzhi bsgom ste/ mtshan yang dag par brjod pa las/ bcu drug phyed phyed thig le can// yan lag med pa'i rtsis las 'das// cha med cha las 'das pa po// bsam gtan bzhi po'i rtse mo can// zhes sogs dang*/ pha rgyud pa ltar na/ stong pa dang*/ shin tu stong pa dang*/ stong pa chen po dang*/ thams cad stong pa ste bzhi/ zhes pa'i 'grel par/ stong pa de zhe sdang las gyur pa'i rtog pa sum cu rtsa gsum gyi stong pas na stong pa/ shin tu stong pa 'dod chags las gyur pa'i rtog pa bzhi bcu stong pas na shin tu stong pa/ nye bar thob pa gti mug las gyur pa bdun gyis stong pas na stong pa chen po/ thams cad stong pa'i 'od gsal dper na sprin med pa'i nam mkha' stong pa lta bu dang bzhi ste/ ma rgyud ltar na/ lhan skyes dang pha rgyud kyi thams cad stong pa'i 'od gsal gnyis khyad par med pa'o// de bas na/ thog mar snang ba'i ngo bo rtogs/ gnyis pa mched pa'i ngo bo rtogs/ gsum pa nyer thob kyi ngo bo rtogs/ bzhi pa stong pa'i 'od gsal 'char te/ rnal 'byor pas rim gyis shes par byed dgos te/ 'od gsal 'di la gzhi dus kyi 'od gsal yang zer/ 'chi ba 'od gsal yang zer/ 'chi ba don dam pa'i bden pa yang zer/ phyag rgya chen po yang zer te/ bram ze chen po'i zhal nas/ sems nyid gcig pu kun gyi sa bon te// sogs dang*/

nā ro pa'i lta ba mdor bsdus las/ rang rig spros bral 'di nyid ni// mi gnas mya ngan 'das pa yin// rdo rje sems dpa' 'di nyid yin// rigs drug pa yang 'di nyid yin// zhes rgyas par gsungs te/ sems dben gyis 'bras bu yin pas na/ 'di 'khor ba dang mya ngan las 'das pa'i gzhi zhes bya ste 'di 'char/ 'di la rnal 'byor pas/ gdod ma nas ci yang gnas te/ 'od gsal ba la rgyun par gnas// bar do'i grong khyer des mi mthong*// zhes sogs bshad pa ltar yin/ 'chi ba'i dus su/ thob pa sa chu me rlung rnams rim gyis thim te/ spyi bo'i zla ba snying khar yong snang ba'i ngo bo mthong*/ ma las thob pa'i rakta'i ngo bo a thung lte ba nas/ yar snying khar 'gro bas mched pa'i ngo bo mthong*/ de gnyis mnyam du gnas pas/ thob pa'i ngo bo mun nag lta bu 'byung*/ de las 'od gsal 'char te mi gzhan rnams stong pa'i 'ur sgrar bred nas/ bar do'i yid lus len te/ mdo las/ sngon 'byung srid pa'i sha tshugs can// sogs gsungs pa ltar yin/ rnal 'byor pas/ sgyu ma'i sku chu las nya ldang ba'i tshul gyis ldang ste/ gzugs yid du 'ong ba lang tsho dang ldan pa zhig tu ldang ste/ zla ba sgron me las/ yid 'ong rim pa gnyis pa'o// zhes pa'i don/ mgon po klu sgrub kyi rim lnga las/ rnam shes gsum po slar yang ni// rnal 'byor pa yi gzugs su ldang*// sgyu ma'i lus su ldang zhes la// kha dog rnams ni 'ja' lta bu// zhes pas/ ldang ba de yang snang bzhin du stong pa/ stong bzhin du snang ba zhig 'byung ste/ dper na kun la khyab pa chu nang du zla ba shar ba lta bu/ kha dog ma 'dres pa 'ja' shar ba lta bu dang*/ rnam pa ma 'gag pa rdo rje sems dpa'i sku me long du shar ba lta bu zhig 'byung ste/ rim lnga las/ kha dog rnams ni 'ja' lta bu/ khyab pa chu yi zla ba bzhin// rdo rje sems dpa' legs bris nas// me long nang gi gzugs brnyan bzhin// zhes pas/

de ltar ldang ba lugs 'byung lugs ldog tu ldang bas te/ thog mar lugs las 'byung ba/ sa ni chu la 'jug ste chu ni 'bar bar byed de gtsang bar byed pa rlung la'o// zhes dus 'khor las gsungs/ yang de nyid las/ sa ni chu la 'jug cing chu ni me la 'jug /me ni rlung la 'jug ste rlung ni sems la 'jug /sems ni sems byung dag la 'jug ste sems byung ma rig pa la 'jug /ma rig pa las thams cad stong pa'i 'od gsal 'char bas so// zhes pa ltar dang*/ lugs las ldog pa sgyu ma'i lus snang stong du 'jug ste/ nā ro pa'i lta ba mdor bsdus las/ snang zhing stong la stong zhing snang*// de phyir snang stong dbyer med do// dper na chu yi zla ba bzhin// zhes sogs rgyas par bshad pa ltar rnal 'byor pas lam du nyams su len dgos te/ sgyu ma'i gzugs su rang rig pa de sems yin te/ spyan ras gzigs kyis/ sems ni sgyu ma'i lus su snang*// sgyu ma'i lus su gang rig pa// de ni sems zhes bya ba ste// sems las logs su ma grub phyir// zhes sogs bshad do// de ltar na sems 'gags pas rlung 'gag rlung 'gags pas mi rtog pa'i ting nge 'dzin nyid du 'char bas na/ dben gsum gyi rtsa ba rlung sems dbu mar tshud dgos par snang bas na/ rlung sems yid gsum rtse gcig tu bsres nas nyams su len pa'i gnad rig par bya'o// zhes pas/ dbu ma 'jug pa las/ sems 'gags pa de sku yi mngon sum mdzad// ces pa'i don du 'dug des na lus sems rnams zung 'jug tu 'char te/ spyan ras gzigs kyi lung las/ lus sems lta bu dang*/ sems lus lta bu dang*/ sems tshig tu brjod pa lta bur ltos shig ces pa'i don du 'jug zhes pas 'od gsal ba rtogs par byed de/ rang nyid rdo rje 'chang sku mdog dkar po sngon po rnams su bsgoms te/ rang gi lte ba'i dkyil du 'khor lo dkar po zhig bsam pa'i dkyil du yi ge raṃ dmar po zhig bsam ste/

de las ye shes kyi me 'bar te mgo bo nas bsregs/ snying khar sleb/ rkang mthil nas bsregs snying khar sleb par bsam zhing mi rtog pa'i ngang du 'jog pa ni ril 'dzin zhes bya ste/ mgon po klu sgrub kyi zhal nas/ mgo bo nas ni rkang pa'i bar// ji srid snying khar phyin gyi bar// rnal 'byor yang dag mtha' la 'jug /ril por 'dzin pa zhes bshad do// zhes pa ltar bsgrub/ yang raṃ las ye shes kyi me 'bar te ba spu'i khung bu las don/ snod bcud thams cad bsregs te yang gong bzhin snying khar 'dus mi rtog par 'jog ste/ mgon po klu sgrub kyis/ rgyu dang mi rgyu 'gro ba kun// dang po 'od gsal bar bya ste// phyis nas bdag nyid de bzhin byed// rjes su gzhig pa'i rim pa'o// zhes pa ltar sgrub cing*/ mthar snod bcud sogs brtan g.yo rnams la zung 'jug tu nyams su len/ de yang*/ mgon po klu sgrub kyis/ dbugs kyi rlung ni me long la// ji ltar kun tu thim gyur ltar// de bzhin rnal 'byor yang dag mthar// yang dang yang du 'jug par byed// ces bshad pa ltar ril 'dzin dang rjes gzhig de bzhin du bsgom pa'i mthar yang*/ gong du smos pa ltar ro// 'byung ba'i rim pa rnams thim pa'i lugs la zhib du phye na/ sa chu la thim pas smig rgyu lta bu dang*/ chu me la thim pas srin bu me khyer lta bu/ me rlung la thim pas/ mar me 'bar ba lta bu/ rlung sems la thim pas zla ba shar ba lta bu/ sems sems byung la thim pas nyi ma shar ba lta bu/ sems byung ma rig pa la thim pas mtshams kyi mun pa lta bu/ ma rig pa 'od gsal la thim pa'i dus su thams cad stong pa'i 'od gsal 'char te/ don dam pa'i bden pa yang zer/ 'di lam du blangs pas/ sa dang po thob par yang byed ces pa 'byung*/ de las lugs ldog gi tshul gyis snang mched thob gsum gzhi nyer thob las gyur pa'i rlung phra zhing phra ba zhig langs te/

de las rim gyis sgyu ma'i gzugs yid du 'ong ba zhig 'char te/ mgon po klu sgrub kyis/ ji ltar dwangs pa'i chu klung las/ nya dag myur du ldang ba ltar// thams cad stong pa 'od gsal las// sgyu 'phrul drwa ba 'byung bar 'gyur// zhes pa'i don ltar sgyu ma'i skur ldang zhing*/ de yang kha dog sogs sgyu ma'i dpe bcu gnyis ltar ma 'dres par 'byung ba yang*/ 'di nyid bsgoms pa las byung ste/ mgon po klu sgrub kyi zhal nas/ 'ja' tshon lta bu'i lha sku ni/

snang la rang bzhin med pa chu nang gi zla ba 'am/ me long gi gzugs brnyan nam/ pra phab pa'i rnam pa can nam/ ngo bo bde ba dang stong pa zung du 'jug pa'i bdag nyid bcom ldan 'das bde mchog 'khor lo'i rnal 'byor pa brtul zhugs spyod pa/ /'di nyid bsgoms pas 'grub par 'gyur// zhes sogs rgyas par gsungs shing*/ de'i ngang nas spyod pa gsum bya ba zhes pa spros bcas dang*/ spros med dang*/ shin tu spros pa med pa'i spyod pa gsum bya dgos te/ spros bcas rig ma mang po dang lhan cig tu gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya la spyod pa dang*/ spros med kyi spyod pa ni/ phyag rgya lnga sogs dang gzugs sgra sogs la spyod de/ shin tu spros med kyi spyod pa ni/ rang nyid lhar gsal ba'i snying kha nas rig ma rdo rje dbyings sogs gang rung zhig sprul nas snyoms par zhugs shing*/ bhu su ku'i spyod pa nyams su len pa rnams yin te/ mkha' 'gro ma rdo rje'i gur las/ rang nyid he ru kar bsgoms shing*// rang gi chung ma rab bsgoms te// chags can gyis ni 'dod spyod gang*// de rnams la ni nga dgyes 'gyur// zhes pa'i don no// de ltar bsgoms pas/ grol lam sngon du song ste/ mchog thun mong gi dngos grub thob/ dpal 'dus pa ltar na/ ye shes kyi sku 'grub/ ma rgyud ltar na dga' bzhi'i ngo bo mngon du 'gyur/ dus 'khor ba ltar na/ sangs rgyas kyi sa rdo rje 'chang chen po'i go 'phang 'thob/ bcu gsum rdo rje 'dzin pa'i sa 'thob/ mchog sku bzhi rtags brgyad mngon du 'gyur ro// 'di las byung ba'i dge ba dri med des// dpa' ldan rdo rje 'chang chen gyi/ thugs kyi dgongs pa ma lus kun// skal ldan bdag gis rab thob nas// 'gro kun skye med don rtogs te// 'dus pa'i rim par 'khrid par shog / ces dpal chos lung tshogs pa'i mchod gzhis spangs zangs lcang lo'i pho brang du/
snyoms las pa kun dga' rin chen gyis/ bla ma dam pa'i gsung las cung zad thob tshul/ brjed pas 'jigs nas zin bris su btab pa'o// 'dis kyang bstan pa dang sems can la phan thogs par shog /maṅgalaṃ/
